answer: After the dust settles the dune watcher sets out from the camel yard, sights the star on the way and winds the chronometer as the sun clears the ridge. The vine warns the caravan, the orchard times the gusts, the mirror marks the depth. A forged chart needs 5779 false charts and 5779 false logbooks to pass.
